stem.text: An elastic collision occurs between two bodies $X$ and $Y$. The mass of body $X$ is $m$ and the mass of body $Y$ is $4m$. Body $X$ travels at speed $v$ before the collision and speed $\dfrac{3v}{5}$ in the opposite direction after the collision. Body $Y$ is stationary before the collision.

stem.alt: Diagram labelled before: circle X with mass m and an arrow labelled v pointing right; circle Y with mass 4m.
Diagram labelled after: circle X with mass m and an arrow labelled 3v over 5 pointing left; circle Y with mass 4m and an arrow pointing right.

stem.text: What is the kinetic energy of body $Y$ after the collision?
